That falls under pma_income_requirements_start (income requirements for obtaining mortgages or loans). So category: pma_income_requirements_start.

2. "Can I schedule automatic withdrawals for different dates?" This is about scheduling automatic withdrawals. Category: faq_auto_withdraw_start.

3. "How much do I owe on my home equity loan?" This is about checking balance / due amounts. Category: payment_information_start.

4. "Will my income be verified during the loan application process?" This is about verifying income during loan application. Category: pma_income_requirements_start.

5. "Is there a minimum income threshold for loan approval?" Also about income requirement. Category: pma_income_requirements_start.

Thus we produce JSON with keys mapping to lists of queries. The function expects an object with keys: faq_auto_withdraw_start, payment_information_start, pma_income_requirements_start, outofscope. Provide arrays accordingly.

  "faq_auto_withdraw_start": ["Can I schedule automatic withdrawals for different dates?"],
  "payment_information_start": ["How much do I owe on my home equity loan?"],
  "pma_income_requirements_start": [
    "Can I use bonuses or commissions as part of my income for a loan application?",
